description: Whether your watched pages are up and when they were last checked (last_checked_at as an ISO timestamp), so a morning brief can flag downtime without opening Watch. Reads stored results only; it never starts a check. Watch itself is a Starter and Growth feature: on Hobby this returns on=false with a short reason. site_id is optional. Available on Hobby (free) and paid plans.

site_id.description: Optional site UUID. Defaults to your first site. list_sites and add_website return this id.

name: get_watch_status
title: Watch status
